text: The rubella serology and echocardiogram are normal, ruling out congenital rubella syndrome and structural heart defects. Given the macrocytic anemia (MCV 100) and apnea in a premature infant, I suspect bone marrow suppression or a hematologic disorder. REQUEST TEST: Reticulocyte_Count

speaker: Doctor
text: The low reticulocyte count indicates hypoproliferative anemia, likely due to inadequate erythropoietin production from chronic lung disease in this premature infant. I will request a test for erythropoietin levels to confirm this suspicion. REQUEST TEST: Erythropoietin_Level

speaker: Doctor
text: With normal erythropoietin levels ruling out typical anemia of prematurity, and given the apnea and macrocytic anemia, I suspect a metabolic disorder like maple syrup urine disease. REQUEST TEST: Plasma_Amino_Acid_Profile
